claim: Is Zillow really any good for finding a place to rent? - Reddit
summary: Zillow’s good if you want to pay top dollar for a rental. Drive or - better - walk around the neighborhood you want to live in. The cheapest, best rentals will have a sign out front. The landlords don’t need to pay commissions to agents or even advertise, their renters and the neighbors will let their friends know there’s a vacancy. Reply ...
